summary: chat-hitl S6b (cinatra#2571, epic #2564) — suggestion decisions inside the gate CAS. RESHAPES suggestion_decision_ledger from one row per SNAPSHOT to one row per DECIDED SUGGESTION: the shipped core__0079 shape put both the FK and the UNIQUE on suggestion_id pointing at gate_suggestion_snapshots(id), which admits exactly one ledger row per snapshot row and therefore cannot record an accepted/dismissed partition at all. After this migration suggestion_id names a suggestion INSIDE the snapshot payload, snapshot_id carries the FK that used to sit on it, gate_id gains its own FK to artifact_review_gates, decision_fingerprint binds each row to the ONE review decision that wrote it, applied_at is the exactly-once CAS predicate the application drain stamps, and UNIQUE (snapshot_id, suggestion_id) replaces UNIQUE (suggestion_id). ADDS suggestion_application_outbox — the durable application-intent channel, shaped exactly like artifact_review_resume_outbox (PK gate_id, status/attempts/max_attempts/lease_token/lease_expires_at/dead_lettered_at/last_error) because it carries the same exactly-once-persistence / at-least-once-delivery contract; it is written inside the same transaction as the gate CAS that authorized it. NO DATA MOVES and the migration PROVES it rather than assuming it: suggestion_id changes meaning, so up() first RAISES if the ledger holds any row (the table shipped with a reader and no writer in any release, exactly the gap #2570 closed on gate_suggestion_snapshots, so every deployment's copy is empty — an operator who somehow has rows gets a loud stop instead of a silently re-interpreted decision record). Idempotent twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL (suggestionDecisionCasSchemaQueries in src/lib/artifacts/artifact-review-gate-schema.ts, spread into buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries), shipped in the SAME PR (core__0079 / core__0081 precedent). down() drops the outbox and reverts the ledger to its core__0079 shape, deleting its rows first — the restored UNIQUE(suggestion_id) cannot hold two decisions that share an in-payload suggestion id and the restored FK expects suggestion_id to name a snapshot row (the same honest cost core__0081's down accepts). SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: assigned at merge — shipped max on origin/main at build time is core__0091; a concurrent lane may claim 0092 first, in which case renumber-at-merge is normal. migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: owner approval required; the lane never merges.
